<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_COMMON_003>>

kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV04
---
薇拉: 我在会上发过火，后来检测出了狂乱倾向，就被送到这里。但发火的原因，你们问过吗？！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_COMMON_004>>
===

kind: line
round: R2

---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_OPTION_001__MENU>>
===

day: 1

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_004>>

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_002
kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_005>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_003
kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我已经交出腰带，坐到了镜头前。还要怎样才算配合？！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_006>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_004
kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 别把档案改成我从来没有担任过委员。我做过的事，我认；我的经历，也别删。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_001>>
===

kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_001>>
===

kind: line
round: R2
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R2_CLOSE_007>>
===

day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_001>>
===

kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 你看过的那份延长收容的决议，末尾有我的签名。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_002>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_002
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我承认，我签了...这份决议造成的后果，我有责任。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_COMMON_003
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 但那不是我一个人的决定。后面原本有一张附页，记着另外六名委员的表决意见和需要复核的事项。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_OPTION_001__MENU>>
===

kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 另外六个人，无一例外。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_005>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_002
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我从来不否认所作所为。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_006>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_003
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 因为我看过原件，那张纸比前一页窄，装订后会露出一道边。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_007>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_004
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 被收容的人是否需要继续关着，要再核查。那一页还记着另外六个人的联署。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_008>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_005
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 把他们投了什么票也查清楚。谁赞成、谁反对，都不该从记录里消失。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_006
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R3_CLOSE_007
kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 请你自己回去亲自翻，别直接把我的话当结论。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_001>>
===

kind: line
round: R3
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 附页不见了，人就能一直关着，另外六个人还不用被问话。这还不值得查吗？！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_001
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 这里送来的热水，杯底全是水垢。我以前批准过这些街区的供水维修预算。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_002>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_002
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 配给处向我汇报，说管道已经清理好了，居民都能喝上干净水。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_003
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我问有没有去现场检查。他们说：“完工报告已经收到了。”
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_COMMON_004
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 委员办公室里的水是干净的，下面街区的水却还是脏的。我们批准了预算，却没人确认居民到底喝上了什么！

===

kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_CLOSE_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_CLOSE_002
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我们批预算，配给处负责施工和验收。我当时觉得各管各的就够了。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_CLOSE_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_CLOSE_003
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 他们给我看的地方确实修好了。可我没再往里走，就回去宣布维修完成...这是我的失职。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R4_CLOSE_004
kind: line
round: R4
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_001
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---

<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_002>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_002
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 他也参与过那些决议。以前开会，总把椅子往后挪一点，让我先开口、先签字。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_003
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 现在我被撤职、送来接受治疗，他坐上了我的位置。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_COMMON_004
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我的审查还没结束，办公室的门牌已经换成他的了。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_OPTION_001__MENU>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_001
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 你说呢...我不会为了让你满意，就装成自己不在乎权力。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_002
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 有人反对我，也有人反对由他接任。他们争的是谁上位，不一定是谁该被收容。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_005>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_003
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 接受审查，就不能再问撤职的事了？！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_006>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_004
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 但想回去，不等于我签过的决议就没问题。你可以继续追问，我会答。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_005
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 最后没人把我留下。至于那些没说话的人...我现在也不知道，有多少是赞成，又有多少是不敢反对。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R5_CLOSE_006
kind: line
round: R5
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我会回答治疗的问题。也请你记下，我对撤职和收容仍有异议，很大的异议！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_001
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 门外刚有人经过，你就停下了。有人在监督你，对吧？
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_002>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_002
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 不用急着解释。我当过委员，知道一个人怕被上级听见时，会怎么改口。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_003
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我还没说完，你却已经开始看时间了...今天能谈多久，也不全由你决定，是吗？
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_COMMON_004
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 那就先做一件具体的事：核对那张附页，别让另外六个人的责任一起消失。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_OPTION_001__MENU>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_001
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 请记原话，包括我承认签字，也包括我想恢复原职。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_002
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 好，你判断。但判断以前，请你把材料看全。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_003
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我不是来求一份替我开脱的记录。做过什么、没做过什么，都写清楚。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_CLOSE_004
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: ...我也想知道，你能不能真的作这个决定，还是也只能照上面的意思办。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_001>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_001
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 你肯听到这里，我就把那次会议的经过说清楚。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_002>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_002
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 会前有一场晚餐，另外几名委员都去了，唯独没邀请我。第二天，秘书才给我看座次单。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_003>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_003
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 到了会上，有人直接说：“延长收容那一条，就按昨晚谈的办。”我连他们谈过什么都不知道！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_004>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_004
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 我问为什么不让我参加，他却说：“你太激动了，先休息。”我连反对意见都还没说！
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_005>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_005
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 他们先把我排除在商量之外，再把我的不满说成情绪问题。这就是我发火的经过。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_OPTION_003__MENU>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_006
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
---
薇拉: 对，正式表决照样举行，可意见早就串好了。我那时才听到具体安排。
<<jump former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_010>>
===

title: former-ruler__P03_D1_R6_SPECIAL_007
kind: line
round: R6
patient: former-ruler
day: 1
portrait: VV01
